business_scope.primary_industry_name: Multi-Channel Omni-Helpdesk and Conversational Bot Cloud

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (International Companies jurisdiction, administered by the Registrar of International Companies and the Samoa International Finance Authority, SIFA)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid — unwritten English common law, equity, and local statute; unitary national legal system; customary land matters reserved to the Land and Titles Court (not applicable to offshore International Companies)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus), in force 13 December 2020
Samoa–New Zealand Tax Information Exchange Agreement (2010)
Samoa–United States Intergovernmental Agreement on FATCA (2014)
World Trade Organization membership (acceded 10 May 2012) — MFN and GATS commitments

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 (as amended) and Money Laundering Prevention Regulations; International Companies Act 1987 (as amended); International Companies (Amendment) Acts 2008 and 2012 (beneficial ownership registers); Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Regulations; United Nations (Financial Prohibitions, Arms Embargoes and Travel Ban) Act 2009; Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directives; Asia/Pacific Group on Money Laundering (APG) mutual evaluation obligations
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — Beneficial ownership information is confidential and filed with the Registrar of International Companies and accessible to the Samoa FIU and SIFA; the register is not publicly searchable; licensed nominees are permitted only through SIFA-licensed international trust companies, and nominee arrangements are fully transparent to the Registrar

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of passport of each UBO, director, and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National passport authority / notary public of country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming source of funds and banking relationship
Certificate of Incumbency or Corporate Registry extract (for each corporate shareholder)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Home-jurisdiction company registry or licensed registered agent

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing (if parent entity is incorporated in another international finance centre)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registry of parent entity's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (utility bill or bank statement) for each UBO and director
Professional reference letter from a lawyer, accountant, or regulated financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Law firm or accounting firm in the referrer's jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and principals against the Samoa FIU advisories, UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, EU and UK consolidated financial sanctions lists, INTERPOL Red Notices, and APG public statements; PEP determination under Money Laundering Prevention Act 2018 definitions (foreign and domestic PEPs, family members, and close associates); enhanced due diligence and senior-management approval required for any PEP-linked structure; re-screening every 90 days and upon any material event

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) electronic registry and the Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official company name must be in Latin script and distinguishable from existing registered names; Chinese-character or Samoan-diacritic names are not accepted as the statutory name; where the client requires a wholly Chinese-language charter, a Latin-script English/Samoan name must be registered and all Chinese charter texts must be accompanied by a certified English translation filed with the Registrar; the name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or an approved abbreviation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 days of a rejection notice, the applicant may file a written request for reconsideration with the Registrar of International Companies, including three alternative names; if the rejection is based on a sensitive token, obtain prior written consent from the Minister of Commerce, Industry and Labour; a name reservation may be renewed once for an additional 30 days before expiry; further recourse lies by way of judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not a substitute — a physical registered office in Samoa maintained by a SIFA-licensed international trust company acting as registered agent is mandatory under the International Companies Act 1987; virtual mail-forwarding may supplement but never replace the statutory registered office; no physical trading premises in Samoa is required for the helpdesk SaaS commercial model
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the standard low-risk SaaS/helpdesk tier: approximately 10–15% annual probability of unannounced registered-office verification by the Registrar or Samoa FIU; probability rises to 25–40% upon PEP exposure, sanctions-list hits, or a suspicious transaction report

Initial incorporation and registration fee for International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule for International Companies

Notarization and apostille or consular legalization of UBO documents (estimated 5–8 instruments)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified English translation of the Chinese-language memorandum and articles of association
Legal drafting of bilingual Chinese-English constitutional documents and pre-incorporation resolutions
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for offshore corporate drafting

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent file-opening, UBO register setup, and corporate secretarial intake
International courier and administrative dispatch of original documents

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended; ss. 4-8 (registration and incorporation), ss. 20-21 (registered office and registered agent), ss. 23-24 (directors and secretary), and s. 38 (exemption from Samoa domestic business restrictions). The Companies Act 2001 does not apply to an International Company.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Government of Samoa, acting through licensed registered agents; administrative coordination with the Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Registration of an International Company (prescribed Form 1) together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, registered office consent, registered agent consent, and notices of first directors and secretary.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. An International Company may issue one or more shares of no par value; no escrow account, capital deposit, or paid-up capital contribution is required before incorporation. The subscriber's initial share subscription is recorded in the memorandum and register of members.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: Pro-forma First Board Resolution. 1. Share Subscription: RESOLVED that the allotment and issue of one ordinary no-par-value share to the subscriber, as set out in the Memorandum and Articles of Association, is approved and ratified, and the register of members shall be updated accordingly. 2. Registered Office: RESOLVED that the registered office shall be at the office of the licensed registered agent in Apia, Samoa, and the registered agent is approved to maintain the statutory register. 3. Officers: RESOLVED that [Name] is appointed as Director and [Name] as Secretary, each jointly and severally authorized to execute incorporation filings and sign exemption forms. 4. General Authority: RESOLVED that the Director is authorized to issue share certificates, open bank accounts, and engage professional service providers.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage licensed registered agent and obtain name clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent under the International Companies Act 1987 on behalf of the Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Select a Samoa-licensed registered agent and execute an engagement letter with KYC/CDD collection. Instruct the agent to submit the proposed company name to the Registrar for name clearance. The name must end with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', or 'Ltd' and must not contain restricted words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance', 'Government', or 'Samoa' without specific consent. Obtain the cleared name before drafting final constitutional documents.
required_dossiers: Registered agent engagement letter
Name reservation application
Passport or certificate of incorporation of each subscriber
Bank or professional reference for each beneficial owner
Brief statement of proposed principal activity
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused due to restricted words or confusing similarity, select a fresh available name and resubmit through the registered agent within 30 days; no additional fee is charged for one resubmission, but a new clearance application number may be issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and execute Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent and the subscribers; filing not yet made
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English to permit the object of 'multi-channel omni-helpdesk, conversational bot cloud, and all lawful ancillary internet-based business services'. Include the subscriber's share subscription, registered office clause, and registered agent clause. Execute the document before the registered agent as witness; no public notarization is mandatory under the International Companies Act 1987, but the registered agent must retain certified execution copies.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Subscriber's declaration of non-resident offshore status
Registered office consent letter
Registered agent consent form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar later objects to the objects clause or any statutory statement, instruct counsel to re-execute a corrective memorandum and articles with a fresh execution date and file an amending return before certification.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submit the incorporation application to the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Apia, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Through the licensed registered agent, file the prescribed Form 1 application together with the executed Memorandum and Articles of Association, the registered office consent, the registered agent consent, and the consents of the first director and secretary. The registered agent shall certify all copies and confirm the registered office is physically maintained in Samoa. Submit via the MCIL registry counter or the authorized digital filing portal, and obtain an application receipt.
required_dossiers: Application for Registration of an International Company (Form 1)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Registered office consent
Registered agent consent
Director's consent to act
Secretary's consent to act
AML/KYC due diligence file of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a deficiency query, respond in writing or electronically within 14 business days. If the application is rejected for substantive non-compliance, file a new Form 1 with corrected documentation; any state fee paid is preserved for resubmission if the application number is not closed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay statutory fees and obtain Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies / MCIL Ministry cashiering unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Pay the official state incorporation fee of USD 150 (or equivalent in Samoan tala) to the MCIL designated government account or e-payment portal. Produce the official receipt to the Registrar. Upon verification, the Registrar will issue the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the exact company name, registration number, incorporation date, and 'International Company' designation. Confirm that all names of directors and secretary are properly recorded.
required_dossiers: Application receipt bearing a registration number
Government fee payment receipt
Final verified copy of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Certificate contains a typographical or legal name error, return the original certificate and apply for a certificate of correction under the International Companies Act 1987 within 7 days; provide a cover letter detailing the exact correction and any supporting registered agent certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt first board resolutions and finalize corporate governance records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Company Secretary with the Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting or pass written unanimous resolutions, explicitly addressing share allotment, registered office adoption, officer appointments, issuance of share certificates, adoption of the common seal (if any), and approval of the corporate banking mandate. Record all resolutions in minutes, enter the subscriber in the register of members, and maintain the statutory registers at the registered office. Issue executed share certificates to the member.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution and minutes
Share certificates issued to the initial member
Register of members
Register of directors and secretaries
Consents to act as director and secretary
Corporate seal adoption record (if seal adopted)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a required consent or register entry is missing, the board may ratify the omission by subsequent written resolution and the registered agent may file a post-incorporation notice to correct the public record within 21 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Conduct industrial, physical, and environmental licensing screening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL; Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE); Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (SFESA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Confirm that ISIC 6201 (customer support helpdesk) operated as a cloud-based conversational bot SaaS does not require an industrial or manufacturing license and does not trigger a mandatory Environmental Impact Assessment. Document this determination in the corporate records. If a physical support office is later opened in Samoa, obtain a building occupancy permit, fire safety clearance, and occupational health and safety clearance, and confirm that no domestic business with Samoa residents is carried on contrary to the International Company exemption.
required_dossiers: ISIC 6201 business activity statement
Declaration that no domestic trading with Samoa residents is intended
Environmental compliance self-assessment checklist for office-only use
Fire safety and building occupancy application (only if a physical office is opened)
Occupational health and safety risk assessment (only if physical staff are present in Samoa)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SFESA or MNRE determines that the physical office triggers a permit obligation, comply with the inspection and submit the required plan; if the determination is disputed, file an internal administrative appeal within 21 days of the notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None required for ISIC 6201 pure cloud helpdesk services. If physical manufacturing or telecommunications infrastructure were added, the authority would be the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) and the Samoa Telecommunications Regulator.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No statutory industrial operating license applies to a customer support helpdesk SaaS company. Expansion into local telecom services would require a separate license under the Telecommunications Act 2005.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa – Planning and Urban Management Agency
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Category 4 (office and cloud service). No full EIA report or environmental registration is required for ISIC 6201 software and helpdesk operations with no industrial discharge, excavation, or major civil works.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source wastewater, VOC, or combustion emissions. Any electronic waste or office waste must be handled through licensed waste contractors in accordance with the Environment Act 2002 and Samoa waste management regulations. If uninterrupted power supply batteries are deployed, they must be disposed of under hazardous waste controls.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not mandatory for remote-only helpdesk operations. If a physical customer support office is established in Samoa, the company must obtain a building occupancy certificate, fire safety clearance from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority, and comply with workplace safety duties under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Inland Revenue Authority (SIRA), Ministry of Finance – official portal: https://www.sira.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: An International Company (IC) obtains an International Company Number from the Registrar of International Companies under the International Companies Act 1987. No statutory TIN is issued automatically because ICs are tax-exempt. If the IC voluntarily enters the local VAGST net by making taxable supplies in Samoa, it must apply to SIRA for a VAGST registration number using Form VAT-01, with the certificate of incorporation, foreign ownership declaration, and physical address details; normal processing is 7–10 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: An IC may elect to remain wholly offshore and tax-exempt under the International Companies Act, or it may elect to be treated as a resident ordinary Samoan company subject to income tax and VAGST by notifying the Registrar and SIRA. Samoa does not employ US-style check-the-box elections; hybrid mismatch elections under OECD recommendations have no statutory effect in Samoa.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WS$100,000 annual taxable turnover or expected turnover within 12 months; registration is also mandatory for importers of taxable goods regardless of turnover
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping regime in Samoa. VAGST invoices are paper or PDF-based. Electronic filing of returns is mandatory for registered businesses through SIRA's online portal (E-SIRA); API integration is not required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to exports of goods where the supplier exports the goods within 28 days of invoice date, retains proof of physical export, and receives payment in convertible foreign currency. Offshore services supplied to non-resident customers are zero-rated when the recipient is outside Samoa, the services are performed wholly outside Samoa, and the benefit of the services is not enjoyed in Samoa. Customer support and helpdesk services delivered offshore qualify if they fall under this territorial exclusion.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export
Foreign exchange Inward Remittance Certificate or Foreign Currency Purchase/Repatriation record from the licensed bank
Evidence of effective payment from the non-resident recipient
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: SIRA audits may verify zero-rating evidence and claw back any erroneous input tax credits plus interest. Penalties include a 100% shortfall penalty on unpaid/overclaimed VAGST, late payment penalties of up to 25% of the tax, and administrative penalties of up to WS$50,000 per false document. Fraudulent export zero-rating claims are criminal offences under the VAGST Act 2003 and Tax Administration Act, exposing the IC and its directors to fines up to WS$1,000,000 and/or imprisonment up to 12 years.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), established under the Central Bank of Samoa Act 1984; exercises statutory exchange control powers under the Exchange Control Act 1983 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1984, and supervises all licensed banks and financial institutions under the Financial Institutions Act 1996.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Samoa operates a managed-float foreign exchange regime in which the Samoan Tala (WST) is freely usable for domestic settlement but has very shallow offshore market depth. Current-account transactions, including SaaS/helpdesk subscription service fees and after-tax profit remittances, are generally permissible through authorized dealers with adequate underlying documentation, while capital-account transactions such as equity injections, offshore borrowings, and portfolio flows require prior written exchange control approval from CBS. The International Company (IC) incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 is expressly exempt from exchange control legislation provided it carries on no Samoan domestic business, facilitating hard-currency retention and unrestricted offshore profit repatriation; nevertheless, any onshore WST account operation remains subject to CBS reporting and AML screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under the Exchange Control Regulations 1984, all export proceeds must be repatriated to Samoa and offered for sale to an authorized dealer within six (6) months of the shipment date, with 100% of foreign currency receipts mandatorily surrendered into WST unless a specific retention or exemption facility is approved by CBS. For the exempt International Company in scope, mandatory surrender does not apply to subscription revenue collected offshore through Stripe Billing or PayPal, provided such receipts are settled outside Samoa and are not derived from Samoan domestic export activities; any foreign currency credited to an onshore bank account will still be recorded for balance-of-payments statistics and AML surveillance.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency account (WST, USD, AUD) and ancillary Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Samoa Commercial Bank Ltd (SCB), formerly National Bank of Samoa
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational Account in WST and Capital Escrow Account for inbound equity funding

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa has no statutory electronic-money institution (EMI) licensing regime for offshore digital issuers; the Financial Institutions Act 1996 and CBS licensing requirements limit deposit-taking and regulated payment services to licensed physical banks and locally authorized financial institutions. Offshore digital EMIs cannot independently clear WST nor open a CBS-recognized settlement account. The viable structure is to retain Stripe Billing and PayPal as global acquiring and collection rails, with payouts routed via SWIFT/ACH into a licensed Samoan bank account that serves as the ultimate WST or USD settlement endpoint.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Samoa AML/CFT rules under the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 and the CBS KYC Guidelines require authorized dealers to perform customer due diligence with reliable verification of identity. In practice, non-resident directors are not required to travel to Upolu personally where a licensed local registered agent / corporate service provider completes the file under a power of attorney, but at least one signatory or the ultimate beneficial owner must undergo a physical or notarized visual identity check, supplemented by a video or telephonic financial-crime interview. Fully remote documentary-only account opening is not permitted; any CBS-approved e-KYC variant is treated as enhanced due diligence and is applied rarely.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Offshore jurisdiction classification and tax-exempt shell risk under the International Companies Act 1987
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified Certificate of Incorporation, certified Memorandum and Articles of Association, Certificate of Tax Exemption issued by the Samoa Ministry for Revenue, Certificate of Good Standing, two years of audited financial statements, customer contracts evidencing SaaS/helpdesk operations, and cloud infrastructure and payroll invoices demonstrating substantial business activity.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership opacity or nominee shareholding arrangement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully completed beneficial ownership register under the International Companies Act 1987, notarized declaration of ultimate natural-person owners, certified copies of shareholder passports, corporate registry chain-of-title documentation, and registered-agent confirmation of no undisclosed nominees.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unexplained source of funds for inbound capital injection or equity escrow funding
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Originating shareholder bank statements for the preceding six months, board resolution approving share allotment and capital contribution, share subscription agreement, capital contribution receipt memorandum, and source-of-wealth statement executed by the beneficial owner with corroborating asset or income evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and politically exposed person (PEP) screening hits
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Reputable automated sanctions screening output clearing the entity and all beneficial owners against UN, EU, OFAC, and Samoa FIU lists, PEP determination matrix together with risk rating, signed compliance sign-off by the Money Laundering Compliance Officer, and legal opinion where false-positive matches arise.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk payment geography from subscription customers located in sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Transaction geography monitoring framework, merchant customer due diligence procedures, contractual standard terms restricting services to sanctioned jurisdictions, screening of the SaaS/helpdesk subscriber base, and periodic transactional reviews reported to the bank relationship manager.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity funding is routed by SWIFT MT103 from the shareholder account to the IC operational or capital escrow account at BSP (Samoa) Ltd or Samoa Commercial Bank Ltd, designated with balance-of-payments purpose code for equity investment and credit to the statutory share capital account. The compliance verification pack comprises the board resolution approving the share allotment, share subscription agreement, CBS exchange-control exemption confirmation for the International Company, source-of-funds bank statements, and pre-notification to the relationship manager. USD or AUD clearing through correspondent banks is preferred to avoid thin WST market friction, with WST conversion limited to documented local operating expenditure.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For a Helpdesk SaaS and conversational-bot cloud business with no physical goods movement, outbound clearing uses SWIFT MT103 for vendor payments, cloud infrastructure licensing, and dividend or profit distributions; commercial letters of credit are not applicable to service disbursements and are reserved only for any future server-hardware capital purchases. All outbound payments require underlying contracts, original invoices, calculation memoranda, and CBS exchange control approval where the IC exemption does not apply; Stripe and PayPal payouts function as the inbound collection rail, while domestic WST operating expenses are cleared directly through the onshore bank account.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore WST/USD forward contracts with authorized dealers (BSP and SCB) supported by underlying invoices and capped at a tenor of 12 months
Cross-currency swap (WST/USD) limited to one-way balance-sheet exposure and subject to CBS authorized-dealer approval and documentation of underlying commercial need
Natural hedging via multi-currency operating accounts (WST, USD, AUD) with matched bill-in-currency discipline to minimize conversion exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee Renewal Declaration (International Company annual fee payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), International Companies Registry, Apia, Samoa
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation date each year; the licensed registered agent must remit the fee and renewal confirmation on or before the exact anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Arrears surcharge accrues from the day after the due date; if the annual fee remains unpaid for six consecutive months, the Registrar may commence administrative strike-off proceedings; restoration requires settlement of all arrears, late fees, a restoration fee, and an application via the registered agent.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership Confirmation and Register Update Filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MCIL International Companies Registry, filed through the licensed registered agent under Samoa's AML/CFT beneficial ownership regime
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due concurrently with the annual fee renewal on the anniversary of incorporation; any share transfer must be reflected in the beneficial ownership register within 30 days of the transfer completion
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: No separate government filing fee; inaccurate or stale UBO information exposes the company and its registered agent to AML/CFT fines and regulatory sanctions, with administrative strike-off for continued non-compliance.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: None for this entity: Samoa International Companies that do not hold a license to conduct banking, insurance, or regulated investment business are exempt from statutory audit and from filing financial statements; this helpdesk/SaaS International Company with no Samoan-source income triggers no compulsory audit criteria.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS (voluntary basis only, if financial statements are prepared or audited at shareholder or lender request); no mandatory Local GAAP filing framework applies to tax-exempt International Companies.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: At each anniversary date the registered agent obtains a written confirmation of the complete beneficial ownership chain; every share transfer recorded during the year and any director or registered office change must be captured in the UBO register within 30 days of effectiveness; the register is kept confidential and produced only to the Registrar or a competent AML/CFT authority upon request, with no public UBO disclosure.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600 - USD 1,200 per annum (licensed registered agent, registered office provider, and annual fee handling)
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - USD 5,000 per annum (optional voluntary audit by a Samoa-licensed or internationally recognized audit firm only)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Samoa International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 2012 is a statutory tax-exempt zone entity: 0% corporate income tax on foreign-source income, 0% dividend withholding tax, and full exemption from capital gains tax, stamp duty, and estate duty. The IC pays only the annual government fee and the registered agent professional fee. Resident commercial companies (non-IC) pay 25% CIT on worldwide income, so the IC structure converts the headline 25% rate into a 0% effective rate for offshore multi-channel helpdesk and conversational bot cloud revenue, provided no Samoan-source income is derived.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return (Form IC-AR) filed with the Registrar of International and Foreign Companies via the Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) e-Companies portal; annual fee settlement effected through the Samoa Ministry of Revenue (MoR) eServices system. No corporate income tax return is required to be filed with the MoR by a tax-exempt IC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual fee is payable on or before each anniversary of incorporation; the annual return must be lodged within 6 months after each anniversary of incorporation. Tax-exempt status is maintained exclusively by timely payment of the annual fee and submission of the annual return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: IC registration number and exact registered name, including former names used in the preceding 12 months.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the number issued at incorporation; non-resident beneficial owners are not disclosed on the public register and must be identified only in the confidentiality register held by the licensed registered agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in Samoa and licensed registered agent name, licence number, physical address, and contact details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be a Samoa-licensed registered agent with a physical office; a post office box alone is not acceptable; the agent must hold original passport, proof of address, and bank reference for each non-resident director and shareholder.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors: full legal name, residential address, nationality, passport number, and date of birth of each director.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted without a Samoan tax identification number; notarised passport copies and address evidence must be lodged with the registered agent, and any change of directors within the year must be recorded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholders and beneficial owners: name, address, class of shares, number of shares, and percentage ownership held.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bearer shares are prohibited; non-resident shareholders must be named in the confidential register; nominee shareholding arrangements must be fully disclosed to the registered agent under Samoa's AML/CFT rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital, share classes, currency denomination, and confirmation of the consideration received for issued shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State share capital in USD or WST; no minimum capital requirement applies; verify that no shares were issued for consideration that violates the International Companies Act 2012 or exchange control rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Statutory declaration confirming that the IC has not carried on business in Samoa, has not derived Samoan-source income, and does not hold Samoan real estate except as expressly permitted.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: This declaration is the legal foundation of the tax-exempt offshore regime; making it falsely exposes directors to tax fraud liability; a helpdesk SaaS model with no Samoan customers, no local bank account, and no physical activity in Samoa satisfies the declaration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to pay the annual fee or file the annual return within the prescribed period attracts a late penalty of 10% of the outstanding annual fee plus default interest of 1% per month; default continuing beyond 6 months empowers the Registrar to strike the IC off the register without refund, whereupon the company's assets vest in the Samoan Crown; reinstatement, if permitted, requires settlement of all arrears, penalties, and a restoration surcharge and is subject to a 5-year bar where striking-off was deliberate; directors of a struck-off IC remain personally liable for debts incurred during the default period and may be subject to travel restrictions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by an International Company to any shareholder, whether resident or non-resident, because IC distributions are wholly outside the Samoan income tax and withholding tax net. By contrast, dividends paid by a resident commercial company (non-IC) to a non-resident shareholder are subject to a domestic non-resident withholding tax of 15%, reducible under an applicable double tax agreement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For Samoan resident commercial companies, treaty relief under Samoa's double tax agreements with Australia and New Zealand requires: (i) the non-resident payee obtains a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from its home jurisdiction tax authority; (ii) the Samoan payer files the TRC together with a completed withholding tax reduction application (MoR Form WHT-1) and supporting documentation (share certificates, loan agreements, service contracts) with the Samoa Ministry of Revenue before or at the time of payment; (iii) the MoR issues a written relief determination allowing the reduced domestic withholding rate; (iv) the burden of proving beneficial ownership rests entirely on the taxpayer. For an International Company, the treaty relief protocol is unnecessary because the domestic dividend withholding rate is already 0%.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory domestic rates are 15% withholding tax on interest and 15% on royalties paid by a Samoan resident company to a non-resident; payments made by an IC to non-residents are outside the Samoan withholding regime entirely and incur 0% Samoan tax. Under the Samoa-Australia and Samoa-New Zealand DTAs, interest and royalties are capped at a 10% treaty rate, conditional on beneficial ownership and completion of the TRC procedure. Licence fees paid by non-resident customers to a Samoan IC for cloud helpdesk software and conversational bot usage are not subject to any Samoan royalty or services withholding tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer pricing documentation threshold is published in the Income Tax Act 2015; the Samoa Ministry of Revenue applies the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines and in administrative practice requires contemporaneous documentation where cross-border related-party transactions exceed WST 2,000,000 per annum, aligned with the large taxpayer classification regime. A tax-exempt IC is not required to file a Local File or Master File with the MoR for its offshore SaaS operations, but must retain intercompany agreements, pricing matrices, board resolutions, and cost allocation records demonstrating arm's-length pricing in case the IC's exempt status or the group's Samoan subsidiary's deductions are challenged.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Samoa applies OECD-standard Economic Substance Regulations to International Companies. An IC must (i) be incorporated and maintain a registered office and licensed registered agent in Samoa; (ii) for geographically mobile activities, including digital services, demonstrate in its annual economic substance declaration adequate physical premises, qualified employees, core income-generating activity, and operational expenditure in Samoa proportionate to its declared business; and (iii) file an annual economic substance declaration. Failure to satisfy the substance test attracts penalties up to WST 500,000, forced deregistration, and heightened exposure to automatic exchange of information. A helpdesk SaaS IC operated with zero Samoan employees, fully cloud-hosted infrastructure, and passive subscription revenue is at elevated risk of failing the substance test and being reclassified as a non-tax-transparent shell.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Filing the IC annual return declaration containing false information, deliberately concealing Samoan-source income, or using the IC to disguise a Samoan trading business through domestic customers, local employees, or local bank accounts while claiming tax-exempt offshore status.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty of treble the tax evaded plus interest at the prescribed rate under the Tax Administration Act 2015; fines up to WST 1,000,000; criminal conviction carries imprisonment of up to 5 years; the IC's tax-exempt status is revoked with retrospective assessment of 25% CIT on all concealed income.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and shadow directors are jointly and severally liable for unpaid tax and penalties where the corporate veil is pierced; the Registrar and the Ministry of Revenue may impose travel bans and asset-freezing orders; knowing signature of a false statutory declaration is independently punishable by imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Prohibited Domestic Trading by International Company
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: An IC carrying on business in Samoa, deriving Samoan-source income, holding Samoan real estate, or operating as a bank, trust, or insurance company without the required licence or exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine of WST 100,000 per month of continued breach, mandatory deregistration, forfeiture of profits derived from the unlawful Samoan activity, and refusal of reinstatement for a period of 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorised the prohibited trading face personal civil restitution to creditors and the Crown, disqualification from acting as a director of any Samoan company for up to 10 years, and personal liability for the company's income tax, VAT, and employment obligations arising from the unlawful activity.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company and Anti-Money Laundering Abuse
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as a shell for undisclosed beneficial ownership, nominee concealment, laundering of fraud proceeds, or sanctions evasion; failing to maintain beneficial ownership records; obstructing FIU requests or Common Reporting Standard (CRS) disclosure obligations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Samoa's AML/CFT legislation and FIU enforcement powers: entity fines up to WST 2,000,000, forfeiture of all tainted property, deregistration, and referral to the Attorney-General for criminal prosecution; money laundering offences carry imprisonment up to 10 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Registered agents and directors are jointly liable for AML compliance failures; individual fines reach WST 500,000; travel bans, passport seizure, and freezing of personal bank accounts may be ordered; directors of a shell IC used in fraud are personally liable to defrauded third parties on an agency and dishonest-assistance basis.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer Pricing Mispricing and Thin Capitalisation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: A Samoan operating subsidiary of the helpdesk group transacting with the IC or foreign affiliates at non-arm's-length prices, or stripping Samoan taxable profits through excessive interest on shareholder loans without valid intercompany documentation and economic substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Ministry of Revenue may adjust taxable income to the arm's-length result, deny interest deductions on excessive debt under thin capitalisation rules, and impose a documentation-default penalty of 50% of the tax attributable to the adjustment, plus statutory interest.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign transfer pricing documentation known to be false are criminally liable under the Tax Administration Act; where the entity is insolvent or struck off, directors and the controlling shareholder may be jointly assessed for the adjusted tax, interest, and penalties.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Failure to File Annual Return, Economic Substance Declaration, and CRS
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Repeated non-payment of the annual fee, non-filing of the IC annual return or economic substance declaration, and refusal to report beneficial ownership or financial accounts under CRS and exchange-of-information requests.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Strike-off with loss of legal personality and vesting of assets in the Samoan Crown; late penalties of 10% plus 1% monthly interest; economic substance penalties up to WST 500,000; CRS non-disclosure fines up to WST 250,000 per undisclosed account.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors of a struck-off IC remain personally liable for debts incurred after deregistration; travel bans may be imposed pending compliance; disqualification orders of up to 10 years apply where defaults arise from wilful neglect; directors may also be compelled to cooperate with foreign tax authority requests through Samoan court orders.
